description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointed Members of the Wages Boards for the Rubber Export Trade for the Liquor and Vinegar Trade and for the Building Trade for a period of 03 years commencing from 16.02.2016
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively lists appointments of named individuals (Mrs. C. Waniganayaka, Mr. D. M. S. Dissanayaka, etc.) to various Wages Boards. It provides only their names and basic titles/roles (e.g., "Nominated Members," "Employers’ Representatives," "Employees’ Representatives") without describing any detailed portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. The appointments are made by the Minister of Labour, but the content focuses solely on personnel changes, fitting the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
